description: This Java class defines a custom Hibernate identifier generator that overrides the default generation of entity IDs. It allows IDs to be assigned manually at runtime if already set, otherwise it generates new IDs automatically.

classes.name: NativeIfNotAssignedIdentityGenerator
classes.description: A Hibernate identifier generator that allows override of generated IDs with assigned IDs at runtime.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a primary key for an entity, using a provided ID if already assigned, otherwise generating a new one.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the generator by setting the entity name from the provided parameters.
